harry: Heads-up: BlueTrail (acct BT-77) is disputing April charges. Claim is that a partial deployment never went live so they want a prorated refund of $6,250 and to split the remainder into 2 payments. Invoice INV-2044-501 currently outstanding $18,750.
collections-bot: [auto] invoice INV-2044-501 status=open balance=18750 last_attempt=1850000000
claire: Do we have deployment-confirmation logs? If it never served traffic we can credit. If it served some traffic we should prorate based on active hours.
dani: Quick check: deployment record shows created 2026-04-02T09:12 but first served request at 2026-04-02T18:05. That is ~9 hours active in billing window.
evan: Pro-rate calc: daily rate = (monthly plan portion) -> customer's monthly infra component for that env = $25k/month => hourly = 25,000/720 = 34.722. 9 hours ~= $312.50. But customer says $6,250 which sounds like they expected full-day removal for several features.
meera: Legal/CS note: customer sent a screenshot of a failed rollout at 2026-04-02 08:00. They want a good-faith settlement: refund 6,250 and a 60-day payment plan for the remainder. Need finance approval for >$5k credit.
harry: I'm leaning to offer a partial good-faith credit to close the dispute quickly. Suggest credit $5,000 (explicit approval threshold). Remaining balance 13,750 -> split into 2 payments of 6,875 each, plan fee $75.
claire: Risk check: customer history clean, no prior collections. Approve $5,000 credit and payment plan. Approved_by=claire timestamp=1850002000 :white_check_mark:
dani: Commands (internal): PATCH /internal/finance/credits/create {"invoice":"INV-2044-501","amount":5000,"reason":"Good-faith deployment dispute settlement"} POST /internal/finance/payment_plans {"invoice":"INV-2044-501","schedule":["2026-05-05","2026-06-05"],"amounts":[6875,6875],"fee":75}
collections-bot: [auto] provisional credit CN-940 created amount=5000 status=pending_upload_of_signed_settlement. Plan PP-2044-7 created in draft state.
meera: I'll send settlement agreement for e-sign and request ACH confirmation. Condition: signed settlement must be uploaded to ZD #47221 before charges run.
harry: Customer signed and uploaded settlement at 1850003500. Proceed to apply credit and schedule charges.

harry: Great, services remain active. I'll update ZD #47221 and flag ops to add a health-check to detect failed rollouts. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
